Platform/toolchain differences may affect timing (e.g., 32-bit vs 64-bit, different libc/libm behavior, compiler flags). The instance evidence does not specify OS/arch/compiler, so reproduction may require matching the original build environment as closely as possible.

If the buggy behavior is only present in the legacy/relevant MT19937 zipf path, ensure you are running the exact test file/class (`test_generator_mt19937_regressions.py`), which targets `self.mt19937.zipf(...)` specifically.
Because the test does not check for exceptions, the NaN case is not part of the provided regression test; only the `a_near_1` case is guaranteed to be exercised by `test_zipf_a_near_1`.
